element.reason: DS-COMPLETE round 3 (D3, option a): the banner row (brand slot, named primary navigation, actions) as one stock item with media, content and actions; the brand slot takes the pinned logo from the host. Composed through the Designer create path from pinned stock aria-nova parts only (components.button, components.item); no raw styled markup, no restyle of a part, every word a Writer copy prop. Replaces v1 (derived lineage, failing ref-verbatim). site-header-v2 follow-up: preview.copy carries the pinned Writer text of every key the fixtures name, so the Studio specimen renders Writer copy; the brand fixture is the Writer brand name (the specimen renderer mounts no other slot).
